query: SELECT TOP 2 source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,pmra,pmdec,parallax,radial_velocity FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',269.4520769586187,4.693364966576667,0.2)) AND pmdec>9000
note: Live ESA Gaia DR3 response, 2026-11-14. The repository target snapshot is labelled SIMBAD; the live test checks this separate Gaia DR3 track using the repository positionAt function.
